0022600088.text: The Bulls open their 2026-27 season at Toronto, and the Raptors have also not yet played a game this season. Toronto swept the 2025-26 season series 3-0, and the most recent meeting was a 139-109 Raptors win in Chicago on March 18, 2026. Chicago is missing Nic Claxton, who is day-to-day with a hamstring injury and questionable to play, while Toronto is without Brandon Ingram (out, recovering from Achilles surgery) and has Chucky Hepburn (hamstring) and Nate Bittle (foot) listed as day-to-day and questionable; ESPN's matchup predictor gives the Bulls a 25% chance to win.
